name: JM Press (Smith Machine)
description: The JM press performed in a Smith machine for added safety and stability. This hybrid movement between a close-grip bench press and a skullcrusher emphasizes triceps strength at the sticking point. The Smith allows solo heavy work without fear of bar path deviation.

execution.starting_position: Set up for JM Press (Smith Machine) in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for JM Press (Smith Machine).
steps: Step 1: Set up under Smith bar as for close-grip bench. Lie on flat bench.
Step 2: Unhook bar with close grip. Keep elbows slightly outside shoulder width.
Step 3: Lower bar toward chin or throat with elbows flaring naturally.
Step 4: Press back up focusing on tricep lockout.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Lowering too deep causing shoulder strain
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Bar path goes to throat, not chest
